Name: Wizard Ku's Anime Portrait Mods (All Marriage Candidates)
Author: WizardKu
Description:
Portrait pack done in a simple and clean anime style.
I have done all the Marriageable characters (not including beach portraits - this will come in time)

You will need to install portraiture to use these portrait mods.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999

[/url] ﻿1. Place Portraiture mod  in your mods folder
﻿2. Add Wizard Ku Portraits to the 'Portraits' folder inside the portraiture mod folder
﻿3. Start the game
﻿4. When in a dialogue with an NPC press P to switch between portraits.

[b][u]So far I have only done - All Marriage candidates

[/u][/b]Next update I will be working on the rest of the townsfolk.
I'll be doing this slowly but if it's well endorsed then I'll pick up the pace.

﻿Lastly: This is a very simple portrait overhaul of the Stardew Characters heavily inspired and referenced from Gigi's Portrait mods which I love (Shoutout to Gigi!).
If you want to use Gigi's original portrait mods, here is the link:  ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3759]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3759

[/url]Enjoy!
